description: City of Toronto publishes the polygon layer of building outlines from the city topographic mapping, digitised from high-resolution aerial photography in two classes: simple buildings of three storeys or less traced at the outer roof extent, and complex buildings traced as overlapping polygons for individual roof levels, sometimes with rooftop structures; the portal lists files in several coordinate systems (the file names carry the codes 4326 and 2952). Coverage: the City of Toronto; the portal states quarterly refresh and the record was last modified on 2026-04-05. Format and access: GeoJSON, CSV, Shapefile, GeoPackage, downloadable without registration from the City of Toronto Open Data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Open Government Licence - Toronto, as shown on the dataset page (the CKAN API licence field reads "License not specified"); cost: free. Caveats: the portal says the data are manually digitised with a ground accuracy of about 30 cm, that features close to tall buildings or in deep shadow may be missing, that not all features are collected every year and that the layer is not a legal survey; the CKAN API licence field does not carry the Open Government Licence - Toronto shown on the pages; the files were not opened. Simulation uses: building exposure layers for flood, wind and heat models, urban energy-model geometry, and roof-area estimates for solar and green-roof studies. Related catalogue records: Urban Form Toronto: built environment and walkability measures on a 100 m hexagon grid (data-toronto-urban-form-hex-measures); City of Toronto watermain breaks 1990 to 2016 (data-toronto-watermain-breaks); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
